title: Marcus Davenport will retire from football

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Marcus Davenport will retire from football
sources.description: Veteran pass rusher Marcus Davenport didn't request his release from the Bears' practice squad so that he could sign with another team's practice squad.
